verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or staging environment that lets a user test without touching production data. The only related item is multi-tenant containerized isolation, which keeps other users away from your data. That is adjacent tenant isolation, not a test-versus-production sandbox. Users could spin up separate Pods themselves, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Your Pods and workers run in a multi-tenant environment with containerized isolation that prevents other users from accessing your data.
